verdict.rationale: PayPal's Payouts API explicitly supports true bulk operations — sending money to 'thousands of recipients at once' in batch — and this exists as a core REST capability (paypal-docs-5, paypal-docs-24, paypal-docs-41). However, the documented AI-native surfaces (MCP server, agent-toolkit tool inventory) list only single-item operations (create_product, create_invoice, create_order, create_refund, list_transaction, etc.) with no batch/bulk tool exposed for AI agents to invoke (paypal-supp-agent-tools-inventory, paypal-supp-toolkit-frameworks). So bulk capability exists in the platform but is not clearly wired into the AI-native agent/MCP layer. Missing for 10: a documented agent-toolkit or MCP tool that performs batch/bulk actions (e.g., bulk payouts, bulk invoice sends) rather than only single-item calls, and independent confirmation an AI agent can trigger bulk operations end-to-end.
